title: Smell gas? Leave first

scenes.say: You walk in and smell gas.
scenes.visual: a quiet kitchen with a gas stove, late afternoon light, nobody in the room

scenes.say: Do not stop to look for the leak.
scenes.visual: a hallway leading to an open front door, daylight outside
a family's shoes by an open front door, the doorway bright

scenes.say: From outside, call your gas utility or 911.
scenes.visual: a hand holding a phone on a front lawn with a house in the background

scenes.say: Do that before you call anyone else.
scenes.visual: a utility service truck arriving on a residential street

scenes.say: When they say it is safe, we handle the heating and plumbing work.
scenes.visual: a technician's hands working on a furnace with tools, basement light
a clean white plumbing service van parked on a quiet small-town street at dusk, warm lights in the houses

caption: If you smell gas: leave, then call your gas utility or 911 first. After that, call us.
